blocks.text: 2 Samuel 9 contains 13 verses. It opens with: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan's sake? It concludes with: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem; for he did eat continually at the king's table. And he was lame in both his feet. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Second Samuel moves from David's accession and kingdom consolidation through ark and dynasty promise to royal abuse, household violence, rebellion, grief, and a four-part closing appendix.
